rootCause: The skill provides broad framework defaults but does not tell the agent how project-local contracts constrain those defaults, so on contract-driven i18n tasks the agent must infer whether extraction markers, exact file scopes, closed output schemas, locale completeness, and interpolation invariants override the generic workflow; this creates avoidable risk of touching extra files or emitting plausible but invalid output.
reasoning: Evidence 0 is UNASSESSED rather than failing, so I do not claim its output quality from a score. It is nevertheless a clean run (runStatus=ok) with visible inputs and artifacts showing a recurring contract-driven workflow: read an in-repository contract, restrict extraction to confirmed text, preserve exact keys/interpolation, create matching locale trees, satisfy a closed ABI, and verify protected files. The baseline skill mentions scanning, replacement, interpolation, and key comparison, but omits the precedence and exactness rules that connect them to project-local contracts. The change therefore tightens the existing workflow in place rather than adding a competing appendix. Generality test: the same guidance benefits a Vue task with a repository schema and allowed-file manifest, a gettext task with a POT/output contract, or an Angular task whose extraction markers define confirmed text. Rewrite-in-place test: all edits are within the existing project analysis, scan, generation, replacement, and completeness steps; no existing capability or rule was deleted. Coherent-scope test: this is the smallest complete change because contract interpretation still requires framework and source-code judgment, while the deterministic invariants are explicitly listed for verification; a bundled transformer/checker is not justified from one contract shape and no reusable runtime resource exists. No-trade-off test: PER_TASK_SUMMARY.md contains no PASSING tasks, so there is no scored passing task that can regress; the edits also preserve the generic fallback whenever no project contract exists. Task-only restrictions such as no network/package installation and the concrete paths/locales were not promoted into permanent rules.

changes.section: 工作流程（项目分析、扫描、生成、替换、完整性检查）
changes.description: Clarify that repository contracts govern extraction, file scope, closed schemas, locale/interpolation invariants, and final side-effect verification while retaining the generic workflow as fallback.
changes.generality: A Vue locale migration governed by a repository manifest or a gettext extraction task governed by a POT/schema contract would benefit from the same precedence and verification rules.

opportunities.summary: Make project-local contract precedence and the ordering from analysis through side-effect verification explicit.
opportunities.residualDuty: The agent must interpret the project's framework-specific contract and resolve genuine ambiguities without inventing requirements.

opportunities.summary: Treat contract-declared framework, extraction rule, file sets, locales, and output schema as task inputs rather than fixed skill-wide values.
opportunities.residualDuty: The agent must discover the actual contract and supplied values in each project.

opportunities.summary: Extraction, source replacement, locale generation, and reporting form a repeatable pipeline, but the evidence exposes only one framework-specific contract and no reusable pre-change fixture or bundled runtime.
opportunities.residualDuty: The agent performs framework-aware AST/text transformations and selects safe tooling; a deterministic transformer should only be added once its supported contract and independent validation fixtures are established.

opportunities.summary: Visible artifacts support checks for exact ABI fields, locale key/placeholder equality, allowed side effects, and protected-file preservation.
opportunities.residualDuty: The agent must run available project/schema checks, compare file state, and report any unavailable compiler or validator honestly.

opportunities.summary: The observed prohibition on installs/network and absence of local TypeScript are task/environment facts, not permanent skill constraints.
opportunities.residualDuty: The agent must obey the current task's environment restrictions and choose only locally available verification methods.

opportunities.summary: User-visible-text classification, translation quality, framework integration choices, and plural/gender handling remain contextual professional judgments.
opportunities.residualDuty: The agent remains responsible for semantic correctness and must not treat schema conformance alone as proof of translation or integration quality.

inputs: project source and existing i18n configuration
any repository-local i18n contract, schema, or user-declared file lists
preconditions: the task supplies a project to inspect
contract rules are applied only when actually present

constraints.description: Preserve interpolation placeholders and use locale-aware handling where required.
Concrete allowed/new/protected paths, locale names, exact output ABI, and network/install restrictions belong to Evidence 0 only.

residualDuties: classify text semantically when no exact confirmation rule exists
choose framework-correct integration code and translations
use available independent validators without violating task restrictions
verification: confirm locale key sets and placeholder sets match
validate report fields and additional-property rules against any supplied ABI/schema
compare resulting file changes with allowed, required-new, and protected file sets
